node.statement: Apply node 1.2 to the first-index split T=T_0+T_1 with fixed second index R. Conjugating its assembly bijection by J on both domain and codomain produces a complex-linear bounded bijection S_{R,T_0} direct-sum S_{R,T_1}->S_{R,T}; two conjugate-linear maps surrounding a complex-linear map give a complex-linear map, and the displayed compression-adjoint identity identifies it with the canonical second-index assembly map.
